evidence.quote: We are in the process of gradually normalizing both interest rate policy and our balance sheet with a view to extending the recovery and sustaining the pursuit of our objectives.
Today, the global economy is recovering strongly for the first time in a decade.

We will remain alert to any developing risks to financial stability.
